Subject: Finex POC kickoff — onsite + virtual fallback?

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs would like to move to a hands-on POC week so we can validate routing and load before committing to Dedicated. We are targeting two half-days: a kickoff + prompt walkthrough (prompt review, routing examples) and a second day for load/runbook validation (throughput, KV cache behavior).

High-level asks from our side:
- Hybrid preferred: onsite at our SF office (Building 5) with a virtual dial-in for remote folks.
- AV: screen share for two laptops, recording permission for internal review.
- Security: we may need an allowlist IP for the load test window and a short SOC2 questionnaire filled.
- Dates: May 18–19 or May 25–26 (flexible).

I attached a quick requirements sheet (Finex_POC_Requirements.xlsx). Can you confirm Redwood room/AV availability and who from your side will run the load tests? Also please note visitor badge process — we need names 48 hours in advance.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Engineering
Finex Payments

Attachment: Finex_POC_Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)

Date: 2027-05-04T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finex POC kickoff — onsite + virtual fallback?

Samantha — thanks, and great to see Finex pushing this forward. Happy to take lead on coordination. Quick notes:

- We can support both onsite + virtual fallback. For onsite, Marissa will handle room booking and visitor badges. For virtual, we’ll provision a dedicated Zoom link and recording (we require permission from Finex to record — can you confirm).
- Load tests: Karthik will run the simulated routing/load exercises; we typically step up to a target of 100 req/s for routing validation and a separate token-throughput run for generation loads. Please let us know your target QPS and target p95 latency SLO.
- Dates: May 25–26 would be my preference (gives us time to finalize prompts and run a dry-run). If May 18–19 is required we can do a condensed plan.

Action items for Finex:
1) Confirm recording permission for the session (we’ll upload to a shared Drive).
2) Provide full attendee list for visitor badges 48 hours prior (names + company).
3) Share target traffic profile for the load test (average QPS, spike pattern).

I’ll attach a draft agenda and a suggested dry-run window the week prior.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
